idempotent: the same package submitted twice is one entry with a resubmission count
supersession: explicit only, and refused once the older entry has started work

activation_lease.protects: the CURRENT LIVE -> NEXT LIVE transition only
activation_lease.does_not_protect: market research, sealing, cache lookups or candidate planning
activation_lease.ttl: a crashed holder cannot block the factory forever; expiry is recorded, not silent

restage: AUTHORIZED -> CANDIDATE_STAGED is a legal transition: when the live parent moves, the candidate is restaged and its authorization does not follow it
